paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
suggested_experiment_name: JEDI storage-ring polarized deuteron ALP search
coupling_convention: oscillating EDM amplitude d_n in e*cm (axis read-back)
notes: First storage-ring ALP search with polarized deuteron beam at COSY. 90% CL upper bound on oscillating deuteron EDM |d_AC| < 6.4e-23 e*cm over frequency 120.0-121.4 kHz corresponding to ALP mass ~0.495-0.502 neV/c^2 (~5e-10 eV). Primary result is oscillating EDM (Fig. 17), hence AxionEDM in e*cm. The curve varies around ~10^-22 e*cm; the quoted overall bound 6.4e-23 e*cm used as the flat value spanning the narrow mass window. Paper also derives g_adgamma, C_G/f_a, and axion-wind C_d/f_a limits, but the primary measured plot is the oscillating EDM.
